decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - 3 Within 1 month of the demolition of buildings K3, K5 and K6 hereby permitted, a scheme detailing the proposed treatment and surfacing of the land upon which each building was located shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and then be implemented in accordance with this approved scheme within 6 months of date of the decision.

Condition : 4 - 4 Prior to the demolition of buildings 'J-Block' and 'Q-Block', a scheme detailing the proposed post-removal treatment and surfacing of the land upon which each building is located shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and then be implemented in accordance with this approved scheme within 6 months of date of the decision.
Condition : 5 - Informative: The works proposed for the 'finish' to the site amount to development requiring planning permission.
description: Demolition of garage and two portable buildings within curtilage of listed building.
